description.narrative: Communication on gender mainstreaming in mine action: develop a communication plan for ANAMA and share visibility on main communication channels.

comment.narrative: After the approval of the workplan to support the implementation of the Gender Equality Strategy and Policy between UNDP Azerbaijan, ANAMA and the International Gender Consultant, the Consultant closely worked with ANAMA to explore ways to mainstream gender in visibility in Mine Action. One of the key activities included in the Strategy is the development of a communication plan to support ANAMA include gender equality and diversity considerations in its communication channels. The consultant identified together with ANAMA communication tools and practices that can be used by mine action actors to share visibility around gender mainstreaming initiatives in the sector.

description.narrative: Conduct Workshops, Training, technical assessment building on past activities. (Planned focus in 23/24, will be Management TNA, Gender, EORE, VA and Advocacy, Risk Management)

comment.narrative: 1. A training on Information management in Mine Action was held for Regional Information management (IM) (Head of IEPF IM, GIS expert, Reginal IM, APOPO IM), as well as IEPF Information Manager officer by the project IM Consultant on 12-14 December, 2023 in Terter for IEPF staff. 2. The Gender Equality in Mine Action training was held by the project Gender Consultant on 30th November, 2023. 3. A training was organized for 15 medics in Horadiz and Tartar, mainly on equipment that they were not able to use as well as introduction training on ICP (Inductively Coupled Plasma) equipment.

description.narrative: Continue building capacity of ANAMA staff across departments on gender and diversity mainstreaming considerations: development of capacity building action plan and organization of workshops.

comment.narrative: Between September and October, ANAMA was engaged in a discussion with UNDP Azerbaijan and the International Gender Consultant to agree on a workplan to continue mainstream gender considerations in their work. In particular, the workplan foresees three visits from the Consultant to Azerbaijan, to conduct capacity-building initiatives and trainings to staff in HQ and at the field level. The workplan was presented to ANAMA and approved in November 2023.

title.narrative: Land Release, EO removed, Areas Surveyed

description.narrative: Data verified output on Land Release, EO removed, Areas Surveyed.

comment.narrative: Data verification: The IM Department in ANAMA has been reorganized with new staff and the UNDP advisor is not situated within ANAMA. The IM Advisor together with the international Operations advisor assisted IEPF with statistical analysis for report mapping and graphs. A workflow of the information management of IEPF in Terter was reviewed and the current data workflow was revised. The IM Advisor has supported ANAMA during the compilation of the specifications for the new IT equipment for ANAMA. EO removal, areas surveyed: Throughout the deployment to operational fields, the Project teams have surveyed 2,654 km2 of land, by covering 218 villages and identifying 958 km2 of suspected hazardous areas. The explosive ordnance disposal teams have made 437 callouts including from ANAMA, the Ministry of Defense, the Ministry of Emergency, police, and EOD teams observations. A consultant on land release shall be recruited in Q IV of 2024.

description.narrative: Following the successful UK Gender project and the submission of both the Gender Policy and Strategy. This project will build in this by Conduct workshop(s) with mine action stakeholders.

comment.narrative: One of the tasks of the consultant is to build capacity not only of ANAMAs staff, but also of Mine Action stakeholders. Between September and November 2023 and prior to her travel, the consultant revised the Gender Mainstreaming Strategy for ANAMA, assessing its relevance to the current context and needs, and monitoring its implementation. The consultant discussed her workplan with ANAMA at the beginning of November 2023 and agreed on all steps and activities to be undertaken.

description.narrative: Promote exchanges of best practices on gender mainstreaming among mine action actors: organize best practices exchange on gender mainstreaming in mine action between ANAMA and mine action agencies at the international level.

comment.narrative: As foreseen in the Gender Equality Strategy for ANAMA, the exchange of best practices between ANAMA and the international community in Mine Action will boost gender mainstreaming among the Agency, promoting ownership of the process and regional and international visibility. During the month of September 2023, the International Gender Consultant supported ANAMA to identify and introduce a Gender Marker for Mine Action in Azerbaijan.

description.narrative: Provide Strategic advice across the Humanitarian Mine Action Pillars.

comment.narrative: Since 2021 UNDP has deployed three technical staff, that include the Strategic Advisor (Senior Technical Advisor), Information Management Advisor and Survey Advisor. All technical staff have been embedded within ANAMA and have been allocated office space at the ANAMA HQ and work directly with ANAMA and Local Partners. The team is also supported with a Project Manager and Project Assistant, who support this project and the wider portfolio. In August 2023, current Strategic Advisor had accepted the offer to another position outside the country. The project team has immediately announced the position to replace the position.

description.narrative: Research of the contribution of gender mainstreaming in mine action to progress SDGs

comment.narrative: To better track the progress of implementation, the consultant is supporting ANAMA in the development of an online dashboard to show progress against gender equality indicators in. the Gender Mainstreaming Strategy. During the months of October and November 2023, the consultant started working on the development of a dashboard to monitor and visualize gender mainstreaming progress in Mine Action. The dashboard will be composed of different KPIs to track progress in line with the Gender Mainstreaming Strategy. The first draft will be presented to the Information Management Department of ANAMA by end of January 2024.
